definition_zh: 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的；微小的；远程的
definition_en: far away in distance or time, or not closely connected
core_image: 一条土路通向山后，远处的房子小得只剩一个点
scene: 那里没有公交，最近的诊所也在两个小时车程之外。There is no bus service, and the nearest clinic is two hours away in a remote valley.
sceneCN: 这里 remote 是「偏僻的、遥远的」（第 1 个义项：距离很远）；句意：那里没有公交，最近的诊所位于两个小时车程之外的偏僻山谷。

pos.zh: 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的；微小的；远程的

derivatives.zh: remote 加 -ly 构成，义为「遥远地；丝毫（用于否定）」
remote 加 -ness 构成，义为「遥远；偏僻」
与 remote 同出拉丁语 removere，义为「移开；去除」

senses.title: Far away in space or time
senses.definition: a long way from towns, people, or the present time
senses.definitionCN: 距离城镇、人群或当下时间很远
senses.example: They live in a remote village in the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在山中的偏远村庄里。
senses.why: The Latin participle remotus means moved back, so the core image is something pushed to a distance.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁分词 remotus 意为「被移开的」，所以核心画面是被推到远处的某个东西。

senses.title: Distant in manner
senses.definition: not friendly or close, keeping other people at a distance
senses.definitionCN: 不亲近，把他人挡在一定的距离之外
senses.example: His manner was polite but remote.
senses.exampleCN: 他的态度礼貌，却显得疏远。
senses.why: If something can be moved far away in space, a person can also hold others far away in feeling.
senses.whyCN: 既然东西可以在空间上被推远，人也可以在情感上把别人挡在远处。

senses.title: Very slight or unlikely
senses.definition: existing only in a small amount, so that it is unlikely to happen
senses.definitionCN: 只存在很小的一点，因此不太可能发生
senses.example: There is only a remote possibility of rain this week.
senses.exampleCN: 这周下雨的可能性很小。
senses.why: Distance in space turns into distance in probability: what is far off is unlikely to arrive.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的距离会变成概率上的距离：离得远的东西，就很难真的到来。

senses.title: Operated from a distance
senses.definition: controlled or done from a place that is not the place of action
senses.definitionCN: 在非现场的位置进行控制或操作
senses.example: She works from a remote office two hundred miles away.
senses.exampleCN: 她在两百英里外的远程办公点工作。
senses.why: The plain idea of being far away gives the modern technical sense of working or controlling at a distance.
senses.whyCN: 「处在远处」这个朴素含义，给出了现代远程工作与远程控制的技术义。

intro.en: Remote is the past participle of Latin removere, to move back, which also gives the verb remove.
intro.cn: remote 是拉丁语 removere「移开」的过去分词，同一个动词也产生了 remove。

items.en: Removere joins re- with movere, to move, and means to move back or away.
items.cn: removere 由 re- 与 movere「移动」组合，意为向后移开或移走。

items.en: The participle remotus describes something that has been moved away, hence distant.
items.cn: 分词 remotus 描述被移走的东西，因而表示遥远。

items.en: Movere also gives motion, motive, and mobile, all about movement.
items.cn: movere 还产生 motion、motive、mobile 等词，都与移动有关。

items.en: English remote first means far off in space or time.
items.cn: 英语 remote 最初表示在空间或时间上遥远。

items.en: The word widens to cover an aloof manner, a slight chance, and work done at a distance.
items.cn: 词义扩展到冷淡的态度、微小的可能性以及在远处完成的工作。

note.en: Remote shares its Latin verb with remove, and it stands beside words for distance and for aloofness.
note.cn: remote 与 remove 共享同一个拉丁动词，并与表示距离和冷淡的词相邻。

entries.definition: from a distance, or by even a small amount
entries.definitionCN: 远程地；丝毫（多用于否定），由 remote 加 -ly 构成

entries.definition: to take something away
entries.definitionCN: 移开；去除，与 remote 同出拉丁语 removere

entries.definition: the act of moving
entries.definitionCN: 运动；动作，与 remote 共享 movere 词根

entries.definition: far away in space or time
entries.definitionCN: 遥远的，是最直接的近义词

entries.definition: far from other places or people
entries.definitionCN: 孤立的；偏僻的，强调与外界隔绝

entries.definition: not friendly and deliberately distant
entries.definitionCN: 冷淡的；疏远的，与第二义项接近

normalIntro.en: Remote and remove are twins from the Latin verb removere, so distance and removal sit side by side.
normalIntro.cn: remote 与 remove 是拉丁动词 removere 的双生词，距离与移开因此相邻。

normal.en: Re- plus movere, to move, gives something moved away and therefore far off.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 movere「移动」，就是被移走因而很远的。

normal.en: Remove is the verb, remote the adjective, and remoteness the noun.
normal.cn: remove 是动词，remote 是形容词，remoteness 是名词。

normal.en: The movere root also drives motion, motive, and mobile.
normal.cn: movere 词根也驱动着 motion、motive 与 mobile。

normal.en: Remote control and remote access are the two modern fixed phrases.
normal.cn: remote control 与 remote access 是两个现代固定说法。

normal.en: In the negative, remotely means at all, as in not remotely ready.
normal.cn: 在否定句中，remotely 表示「丝毫」，如 not remotely ready。

abstract.en: Picture a single light on a hillside hours away from the road.
abstract.cn: 想象山坡上一点孤灯，离公路还有几个小时。

abstract.en: See a person answering politely while stepping half a pace back.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人礼貌回答，同时后退半步。

abstract.en: Think of a hand controller working a machine in another room.
abstract.cn: 想一只遥控器在另一个房间操纵机器。

examples.en: The farm is remote and hard to reach in winter.
examples.cn: 这个农场很偏僻，冬天很难到达。

examples.en: There is a remote chance that the letter survived.
examples.cn: 那封信还有极小的可能保存下来。

examples.en: He seemed remote and said almost nothing.
examples.cn: 他显得疏远，几乎什么也没说。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞摩托」——想象骑着摩托在瑞丽山里越走越远；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 remotus，是 removere（re-「向后」+ movere「移动」）的过去分词，字面即「被移远的」。

sensesIntro.en: Being moved far away gives physical distance, emotional distance, small probability, and distance in control.
sensesIntro.cn: 「被移远」既给出物理距离，也给出情感距离、微小的可能性，以及控制上的距离。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a house shrunk to a dot beyond the hill.
core.cn: 核心意象：山那边的房子缩成了一个小点。

branches.en: Physical distance is the base of every other sense.
branches.cn: 物理距离是其他所有义项的基础。

branches.en: Distance in feeling produces the aloof manner.
branches.cn: 情感上的距离产生冷淡的态度。

branches.en: Distance in probability makes a chance remote.
branches.cn: 可能性上的距离使机会变得渺茫。

branches.en: Distance in control gives work and access at a distance.
branches.cn: 控制上的距离产生远程工作与远程访问。

branches.en: All three are the same refusal to be close.
branches.cn: 三者都是同一种「不愿靠近」。

intro.en: Remote is a Latin particle frozen into an English adjective, carrying a prefix and a movement root.
intro.cn: remote 是凝固成英语形容词的拉丁分词，带着前缀与表示移动的词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means back, and movere means to move, so remotus means moved back or away.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「向后」，movere 表示「移动」，因此 remotus 就是「被移开的」。

items.example: Re- gives the direction of the move.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 给出移动的方向。

items.example: The mov- root returns in motion and remove.
items.exampleCN: mov- 词根出现在 motion 与 remove 中。

items.example: Movere is the verb behind the root.
items.exampleCN: movere 是这个词根背后的动词。

items.example: The ending -tus makes remotus a participle.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -tus 使 remotus 成为分词。

items.example: Remotus is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: remotus 是这个英语词的直接来源。
remotely 在形容词后加了 -ly。

items.example: Remoteness names the quality of being far away.
items.exampleCN: remoteness 指「遥远」这一性质。

items.example: Remove is the verb of the same Latin family.
items.exampleCN: remove 是同一拉丁词族的动词。

definition_zh: 移开；去除；消除；免职；搬迁
definition_en: to take something away from a place or get rid of it
core_image: 把碍事的一把椅子从过道上端走
scene: 医生小心地把纱布揭下来，看了看伤口愈合得怎么样。The nurse carefully removed the bandage to check the wound.
sceneCN: 这里 remove 是「取下、移开」（第 1 个义项：把某物从原处拿走）；句意：护士小心地取下绷带，查看伤口。

pos.zh: 移开；去除；消除；免职；搬迁

derivatives.zh: remove 加 -al 构成，义为「移走；去除」
remove 加 -able 构成，义为「可拆卸的」
remove 加 -ed 构成，义为「远离的；隔代的」

senses.title: To take something away from a place
senses.definition: to lift or carry something out of the place where it was
senses.definitionCN: 把某物从原来的位置搬起或带离
senses.example: Please remove your bag from the seat.
senses.exampleCN: 请把包从座位上拿开。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to move back, so the core image is a thing being moved out of the way.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「向后移」，所以核心画面是东西被移出了原来的位置。

senses.title: To get rid of something
senses.definition: to clean away or put an end to something unwanted
senses.definitionCN: 清除或终结某种不想要的东西
senses.example: This spray removes grease from the oven.
senses.exampleCN: 这种喷剂能去除烤箱上的油污。
senses.why: Once a thing is carried out of the way, it is gone, which is the sense of getting rid of it.
senses.whyCN: 东西一旦被搬到别处就消失了，这正是「去除」义。

senses.title: To dismiss someone from a position
senses.definition: to force a person out of a job or an official role
senses.definitionCN: 迫使某人离开职位或官方岗位
senses.example: The council voted to remove the mayor.
senses.exampleCN: 议会投票决定罢免市长。
senses.why: A person is moved out of a post the way an object is moved out of a room.
senses.whyCN: 人被移出职位，与物件被移出房间是同一个动作。

senses.title: To move to another place
senses.definition: to go with one's household to live somewhere else, in formal or literary use
senses.definitionCN: 带着家当另居他处，属正式或文学性用法
senses.example: The family removed to the countryside in spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人在春天迁往乡下。
senses.why: Moving a whole household away from one address is the same verb applied to people instead of things.
senses.whyCN: 整个家庭从一处住所移走，就是同一个动词用在人而不是物上。

intro.en: Remove comes from Old French remouvoir, from Latin removere, built on re- and movere, to move.
intro.cn: remove 来自古法语 remouvoir，源自拉丁语 removere，由 re- 与 movere「移动」构成。

items.en: Removere means to move back or away, from re- and movere.
items.cn: removere 意为向后移开或移走，由 re- 与 movere 构成。

items.en: Movere is also behind motion, motive, and mobile.
items.cn: movere 也是 motion、motive 与 mobile 的词源。

items.en: Remouvoir means to move away, to take away, and to delay.
items.cn: 古法语 remouvoir 表示移开、拿走以及推迟。

items.en: English remove first covers physical taking away and dismissal from office.
items.cn: 英语 remove 最初同时涵盖物理上的拿开与免职。

items.en: The formal sense of moving house survives mainly in writing and in the adjective removed.
items.cn: 迁居的正式义项主要残存于书面语以及形容词 removed 之中。

note.en: Remove is the verb at the centre of the removal family, and remote is its distant participle.
note.cn: remove 是 removal 词族的中心动词，remote 则是它表示「远方」的分词。

entries.definition: the act of taking something away
entries.definitionCN: 移走；去除，由 remove 加 -al 构成

entries.definition: able to be taken off easily
entries.definitionCN: 可拆卸的，由 remove 加 -able 构成

entries.definition: far away in distance
entries.definitionCN: 遥远的，与 remove 同出拉丁语 removere

entries.definition: to carry something off from where it is
to remove written or stored material
entries.definitionCN: 删除，多用于文字与数据

entries.definition: to remove completely

normalIntro.en: Remove and its family all sit on the movere root of moving things out of the way.
normalIntro.cn: remove 及其词族都立于 movere 词根之上，意为把东西移开。

normal.en: Re- plus movere gives moving something back and out of the way.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 movere，就是把东西往后移开。

normal.en: The adjective removed also means far apart, as in a cousin twice removed.
normal.cn: 形容词 removed 还表示「隔得远」，如 twice removed 指隔两代。

normal.en: Remove a stain and remove doubt work with the same verb but different objects.
normal.cn: remove a stain 与 remove doubt 用同一个动词，只是对象不同。

normal.en: Removal, removable, and remover all build on the verb.
normal.cn: removal、removable、remover 都由这个动词构成。

normal.en: The magnet phrase remove the barrier pairs well with abstract obstacles.
normal.cn: remove the barrier 这个搭配很适合形容抽象障碍。

abstract.en: Picture a chair lifted out of a narrow aisle so people can pass.
abstract.cn: 想象一把椅子被从窄过道端走，人们才能通过。

abstract.en: See a hand peeling a label off a jar.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把标签从罐子上揭下来。

abstract.en: Think of a name being wiped from a list on a board.
abstract.cn: 想黑板名单上的一个名字被擦掉。

examples.en: Please remove your shoes before entering.
examples.cn: 进门前请脱鞋。

examples.en: The new evidence removed all doubt.
examples.cn: 新的证据消除了所有疑问。

examples.en: The judge was removed from the case.
examples.cn: 这位法官被撤出了该案。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞木屋」——想象瑞丽的木屋被整个搬走，地面空了出来；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 remouvoir，源自拉丁语 removere（re-「向后」+ movere「移动」）。

sensesIntro.en: Moving a thing away produces taking away, clearing away, removing a person from a post, and moving house.
sensesIntro.cn: 把东西移开，衍生出拿走、清除、把某人移出职位以及搬家四个义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chair carried out of a narrow aisle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把椅子从窄过道被端走。

branches.en: Carrying a thing away from its place is the base act.
branches.cn: 把东西从原位带走是基础动作。

branches.en: Once carried away, dirt and doubt are gone.
branches.cn: 污垢与疑虑一旦被带走，就消失了。

branches.en: A person can be carried out of a post the same way.
branches.cn: 人也可以用同样方式被带离职位。

branches.en: A household moves itself away from one address.
branches.cn: 家庭把自己从一处住所移走。

branches.en: Physical removal and its result share one motion.
branches.cn: 物理上的移开与它带来的结果共享同一个动作。

intro.en: Remove is a French verb shaped from a Latin prefix and a Latin motion root.
intro.cn: remove 是由拉丁前缀与拉丁移动词根塑造出的法语动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means back and movere means to move, so remove means to move something back or out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「向后」，movere 表示「移动」，因此 remove 意为把东西移开。

items.example: Re- gives the direction of removal.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 给出移开的方向。

items.example: The mov- root is shared with removable.
items.exampleCN: mov- 词根与 removable 共用。

items.example: Movere is the source of motion and motive.
items.exampleCN: movere 是 motion 与 motive 的来源。

items.example: Removal names the act of removing.
items.exampleCN: removal 指「移走」这一行为。

items.example: Removable means able to be taken off.
items.exampleCN: removable 意为「可以被取下的」。
removed 也表示「相隔很远」。

items.example: Removere is the direct Latin ancestor.
items.exampleCN: removere 是直接的拉丁祖先。

items.example: Mobile keeps the movere root in an adjective.
items.exampleCN: mobile 把 movere 词根保留在形容词中。

definition_en: money paid regularly for the use of a house, room, or land, or the act of paying to use something
core_image: 每个月把一叠钱交到房东手里，换来一扇可以安心关上的门
scene: 月底房东来收钱，年轻人把房租转过去，钥匙仍在自己口袋里。At the end of the month she paid the rent and kept the key to her small flat.
sceneCN: 这里 rent 是「租金」（第 1 个义项：为使用房屋或土地而定期支付的钱）；句意：月底她付了房租，继续拿着小公寓的钥匙。

senses.title: Money paid to use a home
senses.definition: money that you pay regularly to the owner of a house, room, or piece of land so that you can use it
senses.definitionCN: 为使用房屋、房间或土地而定期支付给所有者的钱
senses.example: The rent is due on the first day of each month.
senses.exampleCN: 房租在每月第一天到期。
senses.why: The oldest sense of the word is a regular payment returned to a landlord, so the money itself comes first.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最古老的义项就是定期交给房东的款项，所以「钱」本身是最核心的一层。

senses.title: To pay for the use of something
senses.definition: to pay money to use a house, car, or other thing that belongs to someone else
senses.definitionCN: 付钱使用属于别人的房屋、汽车或其他东西
senses.example: They rented a small flat near the station.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在车站附近租了一间小公寓。
senses.why: Once the payment has a name, the act of making that payment naturally takes the same word.
senses.whyCN: 既然这笔款项有了名称，做出支付行为的动作也就自然沿用了同一个词。

senses.title: To let someone use for payment
senses.definition: to allow someone to use your property in return for money
senses.definitionCN: 允许别人使用你的财物并收取费用
senses.example: She rents out the spare room to students.
senses.exampleCN: 她把空房间出租给学生。
senses.why: The same transaction looks different from the owner's side, so the verb also means to let out.
senses.whyCN: 同一笔交易从房东的角度看是另一回事，所以动词也引申为「出租」。

intro.en: Rent goes back through French to Latin reddita, a word for things given back, especially money owed to a landlord.
intro.cn: rent 经由法语上溯到拉丁语 reddita，指「交还之物」，尤指欠房东的钱。

items.en: Reddere means to give back, and it is built from red-, back, and dare, to give.
items.cn: reddere 意为交还，由 red-（回）与 dare（给）构成。

items.en: Reddita, its feminine participle, names payments or returns that are owed to an owner.
items.cn: 其阴性分词 reddita 指应当交还给所有者的款项或回报。

items.en: Renta appears in medieval records as a regular income drawn from property.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 renta 出现在记录中，指从地产获得的定期收入。

items.en: Old French rente means a yearly income or the money paid for the use of land.
items.cn: 古法语 rente 指年金，或为使用土地而支付的钱。

items.en: Anglo-Norman legal texts bring rente into English property law.
items.cn: 盎格鲁-诺曼法律文书把 rente 带入英语的财产法。

items.en: Middle English rent names both the payment and the holding that produces it.
items.cn: 中古英语 rent 既指这笔款项，也指产生这笔款项的租用地。

note.en: Rent sits in a family of payment and tenancy words, and it is easily confused with the unrelated verb rend.
note.cn: rent 属于「付款与租住」词族，同时容易与毫不相干的动词 rend 混淆。

entries.definition: the money paid or received for the use of property
a person who pays rent to live somewhere
to tear something violently
entries.definitionCN: 撕裂；扯破，与 rent 拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: a legal agreement to use property for a fixed period
to pay to use something for a short time
a person who rents a place to live

normalIntro.en: Rent is a payment word, so the hooks link its letters and sound to money handed over for a place to stay.
normalIntro.cn: rent 是一个「付款」词，所以记忆钩子把它的字母和读音同「为住处交钱」联系起来。

normal.en: The first letter r can stand for regular: a regular payment for a room.
normal.cn: 首字母 r 可以代表 regular：为房间定期支付的款项。

normal.en: Rent and renter share a stem, so the person and the payment stay together.
normal.cn: rent 与 renter 共享词干，付款的人和款项绑在一起记。

normal.en: Compare rental: the ending -al turns the payment into the business of letting.
normal.cn: 对比 rental：词尾 -al 把款项变成「租赁业」。

normal.en: Rent out reverses the direction: the owner receives instead of pays.
normal.cn: rent out 把方向倒过来：房东是收钱而不是付钱。

normal.en: The phrase for rent is what you see on a sign in an empty window.
normal.cn: for rent 就是空窗上挂着的招租字样。

abstract.en: Picture a key handed over only after a folded note passes the other way.
abstract.cn: 想象一张叠好的钞票先递过去，钥匙才被交到手里。

abstract.en: Imagine a calendar with the first day of every month circled in red.
abstract.cn: 想象日历上每月第一天都被红笔圈起来。

abstract.en: Think of a landlord's receipt book filling with identical stubs.
abstract.cn: 想象房东的收据本一页页填满相同的存根。

examples.en: The rent for the flat includes water and electricity.
examples.cn: 这套公寓的租金包含水电费。

examples.en: He rented a bike for the afternoon.
examples.cn: 他租了一辆自行车用一个下午。

examples.en: They rent out their garage to a neighbour.
examples.cn: 他们把车库出租给邻居。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「润特」——把房子打理得润泽舒适，要特别付一笔钱；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 reddere（交还）的分词 reddita（应交之物）→ 古法语 rente（定期收入）→ 中古英语 rent，指为使用土地或房屋而定期支付的款项。

sensesIntro.en: One payment returns every month: first the money itself, then the tenant's act of paying, then the owner's act of letting.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一笔款项每月返回一次：先是钱本身，再是租客付款的动作，最后是房东出租的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a folded payment passed to the owner each month for the right to stay.
core.cn: 核心意象：每个月把一笔钱交给房主，换取继续住下去的权利。

branches.en: The regular payment itself is the first and oldest sense.
branches.cn: 定期支付的款项本身，是最早、最核心的义项。

branches.en: Paying that money becomes the tenant's verb.
branches.cn: 支付这笔钱，成为租客一方的动词。

branches.en: Receiving that money becomes the owner's verb.
branches.cn: 收取这笔钱，成为房东一方的动词。

branches.en: The payment and the paying are two sides of one monthly act.
branches.cn: 款项与付款是同一个每月动作的两面。

branches.en: Both verbs describe the same contract seen from opposite ends.
branches.cn: 两个动词描述的是同一份租约，只是站在两端看。

intro.en: Rent is a short English word whose family grows with endings rather than prefixes.
intro.cn: rent 是一个简短英语词，它的词族主要靠词尾而不是前缀扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin reddere supplies the idea of giving back, and its deeper root dare means to give.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 reddere 提供「交还」的意思，更深的词根 dare 表示「给予」。

items.example: Red- appears in reddere, to give back.
items.exampleCN: red- 出现在 reddere（交还）中。

items.example: Dare is the source of many Latin verbs of handing over.
items.exampleCN: dare 是许多表示「交出」的拉丁动词的来源。

items.example: Reddere joins red- and dare into one verb.
items.exampleCN: reddere 把 red- 与 dare 合成一个动词。

items.example: Reddita lies behind the French word for income.
items.exampleCN: reddita 是法语中「收入」一词的前身。

items.example: Rente passes into English as rent.
items.exampleCN: rente 进入英语后写作 rent。

items.example: Rent names the payment for a home or land.
items.exampleCN: rent 指为住房或土地支付的款项。

items.example: Rental adds -al to the same stem.
items.exampleCN: rental 在同一词干后加 -al。

items.example: Renter adds -er to name the person.
items.exampleCN: renter 加 -er 来表示人。
词尾 -al 构成 rental。
词尾 -er 构成 renter。

definition_zh: 修理；修补；修复；维修工作
definition_en: to mend something broken or damaged so that it works or looks right again
core_image: 把断开的零件重新对齐、拧紧，机器重新转了起来
scene: 老式收音机不出声了，师傅打开后盖换掉一根线，它重新唱了起来。The shop repaired her old radio in a single afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 repair 是「修理」（第 1 个义项：把损坏的东西恢复到可用状态）；句意：这家店一个下午就修好了她的旧收音机。

senses.title: To fix something broken
senses.definition: to mend a broken or damaged object so that it can be used again
senses.definitionCN: 修补破损的东西，使其能够重新使用
senses.example: He repaired the chair with glue and a new screw.
senses.exampleCN: 他用胶水和一颗新螺丝修好了椅子。
senses.why: The Latin verb reparare means to make ready again, so the core action is restoring an object to working order.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词 reparare 意为「重新准备好」，所以核心动作是把物件恢复到可用的状态。

senses.title: The work of mending
senses.definition: the work or act of mending something, or the state of being mended
senses.definitionCN: 修补某物的动作或工作，也指被修好的状态
senses.example: The bridge is closed for repair.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥因为维修而关闭。
senses.why: The noun simply names the action that the verb describes.
senses.whyCN: 名词义项只是给动词所描述的动作一个名称。

senses.title: To restore a relationship
senses.definition: to do something that makes a damaged relationship or situation healthy again
senses.definitionCN: 采取措施，使受损的关系或局面恢复健康
senses.example: The two countries worked hard to repair their friendship.
senses.exampleCN: 两国努力修复彼此的友谊。
senses.why: The image of putting broken parts back together extends from objects to trust and relations.
senses.whyCN: 把破损零件重新拼好的画面，从物件延伸到信任与关系。

intro.en: Repair comes through Old French from Latin reparare, built from re-, again, and parare, to prepare.
intro.cn: repair 经由古法语来自拉丁语 reparare，由 re-（再次）与 parare（准备）构成。

items.en: Parare means to prepare, make ready, or arrange.
items.cn: parare 意为准备、使就绪或安排。

items.en: Reparare adds re-, again, and so means to make ready once more.
items.cn: reparare 加上 re-（再次），意为「重新使就绪」。

items.en: The word is used for restoring buildings, bodies, and broken tools.
items.cn: 这个词被用于修复建筑、身体和破损的工具。

items.en: Old French reparer keeps the sense of mending and putting right.
items.cn: 古法语 reparer 保留了「修补、纠正」的意思。

items.en: Middle English repair covers both fixing objects and restoring a damaged name.
items.cn: 中古英语 repair 既能指修物件，也能指修复受损的名声。

items.en: Modern English adds the noun use for the work and the condition of being mended.
items.cn: 现代英语又增加了名词用法，指维修工作以及被修好的状态。

note.en: Repair belongs to a small family of making broken things whole, and it is close to everyday words for fixing.
note.cn: repair 属于「让破损之物复原」的小词族，与日常表示修理的词很接近。

entries.definition: able to be repaired
impossible to repair or put right
a person whose job is to repair machines
to repair something that is torn or broken
to make something work again
to bring something back to its earlier good condition
the work of keeping something in good condition

normalIntro.en: Repair can be split into re- and pair, and the pair image works well because repair puts two broken parts back together.
normalIntro.cn: repair 可以拆成 re- 与 pair，而「配对」的画面很好用，因为修理就是把两个断开的部件重新配在一起。

normal.en: Re- means again, and pair means two things together: put the pair back together again.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，pair 表示一对：把这一对重新拼回去。

normal.en: A repair shop is where broken pairs of parts are matched again.
normal.cn: repair shop 就是把断开的部件重新配上对的地方。

normal.en: The noun repair often follows under or for, as in under repair.
normal.cn: 名词 repair 常跟在 under 或 for 后面，如 under repair。

normal.en: Repair the damage is the phrase used when the damage is not physical.
normal.cn: repair the damage 用于非实物的损害。

normal.en: Compare reparable and irreparable: one can be paired again, one cannot.
normal.cn: 对比 reparable 与 irreparable：一个还能重新拼合，一个不能。

abstract.en: Picture a cracked cup held together while the glue sets.
abstract.cn: 想象一只裂开的杯子被按住，等胶水凝固。

abstract.en: Imagine a radio with its back open and one bright wire being replaced.
abstract.cn: 想象收音机打开后盖，一根亮色的线正在被换掉。

abstract.en: Think of two people who stopped talking and then carefully start again.
abstract.cn: 想象两个不再说话的人，又小心地重新开始交谈。

examples.en: The mechanic repaired the engine in two hours.
examples.cn: 机械师用两个小时修好了发动机。

examples.en: The school is raising money for roof repairs.
examples.cn: 学校正在筹钱维修屋顶。

examples.en: They met again to repair their friendship.
examples.cn: 他们再次见面，修复彼此的友谊。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞派尔」——瑞气把坏掉的东西派回原样；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次）+ parare（准备）→ reparare（重新准备好）→ 古法语 reparer → 中古英语 reparen，义为修补、使复原。

sensesIntro.en: One image of putting broken parts back together grows into three uses: fixing an object, the work of fixing, and restoring trust.
sensesIntro.cn: 「把破损零件拼回去」这一个画面长出三种用法：修好物件、维修工作本身，以及修复信任。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: broken parts brought back into line until the machine runs again.
core.cn: 核心意象：断开的零件被重新对齐，机器再次运转。

branches.en: Making a damaged object work again is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 让受损的物件重新可用，是最基本的义项。

branches.en: The action becomes a noun for the work and the state of being mended.
branches.cn: 这个动作转为名词，指维修工作以及被修好的状态。

branches.en: The same joining motion is applied to a broken relationship.
branches.cn: 同样的「接合」动作被用到破裂的关系上。

branches.en: Fixing and the fixing work are the verb and noun sides of one act.
branches.cn: 修理与维修工作是同一动作的动词面和名词面。

branches.en: Both object repair and relationship repair remove damage and restore use.
branches.cn: 物件修复与关系修复都在消除损害、恢复功能。

intro.en: Repair is built from a Latin prefix and a Latin verb stem, with a French verb ending carried into English.
intro.cn: repair 由拉丁前缀、拉丁动词词干和传入英语的法语动词词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- adds the idea of again, while parare means to prepare or make ready.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 增添「再次」的意思，parare 表示「准备、使就绪」。

items.example: Re- returns in repair and restore.
items.exampleCN: re- 也出现在 repair 和 restore 中。

items.example: Parare is the stem behind repair.
items.exampleCN: parare 是 repair 背后的词干。
reparare 由 re- 与 parare 合成。

items.example: Old French reparer carries the word into English.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 reparer 把这个词带入英语。

items.example: Repair keeps the idea of making ready again.
items.exampleCN: repair 保留了「重新使就绪」的意思。
词尾 -er 构成 repairer。

items.example: Reparable adds -able to the same stem.
items.exampleCN: reparable 在同一词干后加 -able。

items.example: The prefix ir- makes reparable negative.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ir- 使 reparable 变成否定。
词尾 -able 构成 reparable。

definition_en: to say or do the same thing more than once
core_image: 同一句话从嘴里第二次、第三次说出来，像回声绕回来
scene: 老师没听清答案，让学生再说一遍，学生于是重复了刚才那句话。The teacher asked him to repeat the sentence more slowly.
sceneCN: 这里 repeat 是「重说；重复」（第 1 个义项：把说过的话再说一次）；句意：老师让他把这句话再慢慢重复一遍。

senses.title: To say something again
senses.definition: to say or write something again, either once more or several times
senses.definitionCN: 把说过或写过的话再说一遍或说好几遍
senses.example: Could you repeat the last question?
senses.exampleCN: 你能把最后一个问题再说一遍吗？
senses.why: The core of the Latin verb is to seek again, so going back over the same words is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词的核心意思是「再次寻求」，所以回到同一句话上就是第一个义项。

senses.title: To do something again
senses.definition: to do an action or performance again
senses.definitionCN: 把某个动作或表演再做一次
senses.example: The team repeated the experiment to check the result.
senses.exampleCN: 团队重做了实验来核对结果。
senses.why: Once repeating is about going over something again, it easily moves from words to actions.
senses.whyCN: 既然重复是「再走一遍」，它就很容易从言语扩展到动作。

senses.title: To happen again
senses.definition: to happen again in the same way
senses.definitionCN: 以相同的方式再次发生
senses.example: History often repeats itself in small ways.
senses.exampleCN: 历史常常以细微的方式重演。
senses.why: When an event returns in the same pattern, people describe it as repeating itself.
senses.whyCN: 当一件事以同样的模式再次出现，人们就说它「重演」。

intro.en: Repeat comes from Latin repetere, to seek again, formed from re-, again, and petere, to seek.
intro.cn: repeat 来自拉丁语 repetere（再次寻求），由 re-（再次）与 petere（寻求）构成。

items.en: Petere means to seek, head for, or attack, and it supplies the central stem.
items.cn: petere 意为寻求、前往或攻击，提供核心词干。

items.en: Repetere adds re-, again, and means to go back for something or say it over.
items.cn: repetere 加上 re-（再次），意为回去取某物或把话再说一遍。

items.en: The noun repetitio names the act of going over something again.
items.cn: 名词 repetitio 指把某事再过一遍的动作。

items.en: Old French repeter keeps both the spoken and the renewed-action senses.
items.cn: 古法语 repeter 保留了「重说」和「重做」两种意思。

items.en: Middle English repeat enters through French and is used for words, deeds, and events.
items.cn: 中古英语 repeat 经法语进入，用于言语、行为和事件。

items.en: Modern English adds the noun use for a repeated broadcast or performance.
items.cn: 现代英语又增加名词用法，指重播节目或重演。

note.en: Repeat is the plain verb of doing something again, and its family includes the nouns and adjectives built from the same Latin stem.
note.cn: repeat 是表示「再做一次」的朴素动词，其词族包括由同一拉丁词干构成的名词和形容词。

entries.definition: the act of repeating something
done or said many times in the same way
many times, again and again
to say something again for emphasis
to say something again in a clearer way
to repeat a sound or someone's words
to make an exact copy of something

normalIntro.en: Repeat can be heard as re- plus peat, and the second part sounds like beat, so the word feels like hitting the same note again.
normalIntro.cn: repeat 可以听成 re- 加 peat，后半截又像 beat，于是整个词像把同一个音再敲一遍。

normal.en: Re- means again, and the rest of the word is the thing being said: say it again.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，后面那部分是所说的内容：再说一次。

normal.en: Repeat after me is the classroom phrase that fixes the word in memory.
normal.cn: repeat after me 是课堂用语，最容易把这个词记牢。

normal.en: History repeats itself turns the word from speech to events.
normal.cn: history repeats itself 把这个词从言语转到事件。

normal.en: Compare repetition: the noun adds -ition and keeps the same stem.
normal.cn: 对比 repetition：名词加 -ition，词干不变。

normal.en: Repeat the mistake is a common phrase, so the word can carry a warning.
normal.cn: repeat the mistake 是常见搭配，所以这个词也能带警告意味。

abstract.en: Picture a parrot that says the same phrase at the same time every morning.
abstract.cn: 想象一只鹦鹉每天早晨同一时间说同一句话。

abstract.en: Imagine a song stuck in your head returning to the same line.
abstract.cn: 想象一首歌在脑中循环，总回到同一句。

abstract.en: Think of footprints walking back over their own path in the snow.
abstract.cn: 想象雪地上的脚印沿着原路又走了一遍。

examples.en: Please repeat your name for the record.
examples.cn: 请再说一遍你的名字，以便记录。

examples.en: The class repeated the drill until everyone could do it.
examples.cn: 全班反复练习这个动作，直到每个人都会做。

examples.en: The same argument was repeated at every meeting.
examples.cn: 同样的争论在每次会议上都重复出现。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞皮特」——瑞气重复得特别多；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次）+ petere（寻求）→ repetere（再次寻求、重说）→ 古法语 repeter → 中古英语 repeat。

sensesIntro.en: One motion of going back over something produces three senses: the same words again, the same action again, and the same event returning.
sensesIntro.cn: 「把某事再走一遍」这一个动作生出三个义项：同样的话再说、同样的动作再做、同样的事件再次出现。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same sound or action returning to the starting point.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一个声音或动作回到起点，再走一遍。

branches.en: Saying the same words once more is the basic verbal sense.
branches.cn: 把同样的话再说一次，是最基本的言语义项。

branches.en: The repetition moves from speech to action and performance.
branches.cn: 重复从言语扩展到动作和表演。

branches.en: When events return in the same pattern, the word describes history repeating.
branches.cn: 当事件以同样模式返回，这个词就描述历史重演。

branches.en: Words and actions share the same return motion.
branches.cn: 言语和动作共享同一个「返回」动作。

branches.en: A repeated action and a recurring event both form a cycle.
branches.cn: 反复的动作与循环的事件都构成一个周期。

intro.en: Repeat is a Latin verb built from a prefix and a root, with its noun and adjective family formed by English endings.
intro.cn: repeat 是由前缀和词根构成的拉丁动词，其名词与形容词词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, and petere means to seek or go toward.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示再次，petere 表示寻求或前往。

items.example: Re- appears in repeat and return.
items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 repeat 和 return 中。

items.example: Petere is the root of repeat and petition.
items.exampleCN: petere 是 repeat 与 petition 的词根。
repetere 由 re- 与 petere 合成。

items.example: Repetitio is the Latin noun behind repetition.
items.exampleCN: repetitio 是 repetition 背后的拉丁名词。

items.example: Repeat carries the Latin verb into English.
items.exampleCN: repeat 把拉丁动词带入英语。

items.example: Repetition adds -ition to the Latin stem.
items.exampleCN: repetition 在拉丁词干后加 -ition。

items.example: Repetitive adds -ive to the same stem.
items.exampleCN: repetitive 在同一词干后加 -ive。

items.example: Repeatedly is built from repeated plus -ly.
items.exampleCN: repeatedly 由 repeated 加 -ly 构成。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ition 构成 repetition。

definition_en: to put something back in its place, or to take the place of something else
core_image: 旧零件被取下，新零件咔哒一声装进同一个位置
scene: 旧电池耗尽后，她把新电池放进遥控器，咔哒一声又能换台了。She replaced the dead batteries with fresh ones.
sceneCN: 这里 replace 是「替换；更换」（第 3 个义项：用新东西换掉旧东西）；句意：她把没电的电池换成了新电池。

senses.title: To put back in place
senses.definition: to put something back where it was before
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放回它原来所在的位置
senses.example: She replaced the book on the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 她把书放回书架上。
senses.why: The word is literally re- plus place, so the oldest and most concrete sense is putting something back into its place.
senses.whyCN: 这个词字面上就是 re- 加 place，所以最古老、最具体的义项是「放回原位」。

senses.title: To take the place of
senses.definition: to do the job or fill the position of someone or something else
senses.definitionCN: 承担某人或某物的职责，或占据其位置
senses.example: Email has largely replaced the fax.
senses.exampleCN: 电子邮件已在很大程度上取代了传真。
senses.why: If one thing goes back into the same slot, it can push out what was there, which gives the sense of taking over.
senses.whyCN: 如果一个东西回到同一个位置，就可能把原来在那里的东西挤出去，于是产生「接管」之意。

senses.title: To change one thing for another
senses.definition: to remove something and put a new or different thing in its place
senses.definitionCN: 取走某物，并在原位放上新的或不同的事物
senses.example: You should replace the filter every three months.
senses.exampleCN: 你应该每三个月更换一次滤芯。
senses.why: The same slot is filled again, but this time the emphasis falls on the swap between old and new.
senses.whyCN: 同一个位置再次被填满，但这次强调的是新旧之间的对换。

intro.en: Replace is an English formation from re- and place, where place comes through French from Latin platea, a broad street.
intro.cn: replace 是英语用 re- 与 place 构成的词，而 place 经由法语来自拉丁语 platea（宽阔的街道）。

items.en: Platea means a broad street or open square, and later a position or site.
items.cn: platea 指宽阔的街道或开阔的广场，后来也指位置或场地。

items.en: Old French place narrows the word to a position, spot, or room.
items.cn: 古法语 place 把词义收窄为位置、地点或空间。

items.en: Middle English place names a location as well as a rank or role.
items.cn: 中古英语 place 既指地点，也指位次或角色。

items.en: English speakers add re- to place to make replace, meaning put back.
items.cn: 英语使用者给 place 加 re- 构成 replace，意为「放回」。

items.en: The sense widens from putting back to filling a position left by another.
items.cn: 词义从「放回」扩展到「填补他人留下的位置」。

items.en: Modern English uses replace for both restoring and substituting.
items.cn: 现代英语中 replace 既可表示放回，也可表示替换。

note.en: Replace sits between putting back and swapping out, and its family covers the act, the ability, and the impossibility of substitution.
note.cn: replace 介于「放回」与「换掉」之间，其词族涵盖替换的动作、可能性与不可替代性。

entries.definition: the act of replacing, or the thing that replaces
able to be replaced
too special to be replaced
to use one thing instead of another
to replace something, especially by force or over time
entries.definitionCN: 取代，尤指逐步或强行取代

entries.definition: to force something out of its usual place
to put something back into its former state

normalIntro.en: Replace is transparent: re- means again, and place means position, so the word pictures something returning to a slot.
normalIntro.cn: replace 的构词很透明：re- 表示再次，place 表示位置，合起来就是「重新回到一个位置」。

normal.en: Re- plus place: put it back in place.
normal.cn: re- 加 place：把它放回原处。

normal.en: Replace with is the phrase for a swap: old out, new in.
normal.cn: replace with 是替换的固定搭配：旧的出去，新的进来。

normal.en: Be replaced by turns the sentence around and puts the newcomer first.
normal.cn: be replaced by 把句子倒过来，让新来者作主语。

normal.en: Replaceable and irreplaceable differ only by the negative prefix.
normal.cn: replaceable 与 irreplaceable 只差一个否定前缀。

normal.en: A replacement part is a part that goes into the same slot.
normal.cn: replacement part 就是装进同一个位置的零件。

abstract.en: Picture a battery sliding out and a fresh one clicking in.
abstract.cn: 想象旧电池滑出，新电池咔哒一声装进去。

abstract.en: Imagine a name plate being unscrewed from an office door.
abstract.cn: 想象办公室门上的名牌被拧下来换掉。

abstract.en: Think of a book returned to the exact gap it left on the shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象一本书被放回书架上原来那个空隙。

examples.en: Please replace the tools when you have finished.
examples.cn: 用完后请把工具放回原处。

examples.en: Robots have replaced many workers on the production line.
examples.cn: 机器人已经取代了生产线上的许多工人。

examples.en: The hospital replaced all the old beds last year.
examples.cn: 医院去年更换了所有旧病床。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（重新）+ place（位置）＝重新放回位置，进而表示替换；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: re-（重新、再次）+ place（位置，源自拉丁语 platea「宽街、场地」），16 世纪英语内部构成，本义「放回原处」，后引申为「取代、替换」。

sensesIntro.en: One slot is filled again: first the object simply goes back, then it takes over the slot, and finally the old and new are swapped.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个位置被再次填满：先只是把东西放回去，再是它占据这个位置，最后是新旧对换。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an empty slot filled again by something new or returning.
core.cn: 核心意象：空出的位置被重新填入，或被新物占据。

branches.en: Putting the same object back is the literal re- plus place sense.
branches.cn: 把同一个物件放回去，是 re- 加 place 的字面义。

branches.en: When the newcomer fills the slot, it takes the place of what was there.
branches.cn: 新来者占据位置时，就取代了原本在那里的东西。

branches.en: The slot stays, but the thing inside is deliberately swapped.
branches.cn: 位置不变，但里面的东西被有意换掉。

branches.en: Returning and taking over both depend on the same fixed position.
branches.cn: 放回与接管都依赖同一个固定位置。

branches.en: Substitution and replacement describe the same handover from different angles.
branches.cn: 取代与替换从不同角度描述同一次交接。

intro.en: Replace is an English prefix-and-word formation whose second element comes from Latin through French.
intro.cn: replace 是英语用前缀加单词构成的词，后一部分经法语来自拉丁语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin platea gives the idea of a broad place or position, which becomes English place.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 platea 提供「宽阔场地、位置」的意思，后来成为英语 place。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 replace 与 restore 开头。

items.example: Place is the base of replace.
items.exampleCN: place 是 replace 的基础词。

items.example: Platea is the distant source of place.
items.exampleCN: platea 是 place 的远源。
replace 由 re- 与 place 合成。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ment 构成 replacement。

items.meaning: the act or thing that replaces
items.exampleCN: replacement 在 replace 后加 -ment。
replaceable 在 replace 后加 -able。

items.example: The prefix ir- makes replaceable negative.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ir- 使 replaceable 变成否定。
词尾 -able 构成 replaceable。
词尾 -ible 出现在 irreplaceable 中。

definition_zh: 替换；代替；替代者；替换物
definition_en: the act of replacing someone or something, or the person or thing that takes their place
core_image: 空出来的工位上，新来的人坐下，桌上的名牌换成了另一个名字
scene: 老队长受伤后，教练从替补席叫上一名球员，这次换人没有打乱阵型。The replacement slotted into the team without any confusion.
sceneCN: 这里 replacement 是「替补者；替代者」（第 3 个义项：接替他人位置的人）；句意：这名替补顺利融入球队，没有造成混乱。

senses.title: The act of replacing
senses.definition: the act of removing something and putting another thing in its place
senses.definitionCN: 取走某物并在原位放上另一物的动作
senses.example: The replacement of the old windows took two days.
senses.exampleCN: 更换旧窗户花了两天时间。
senses.why: The noun first names the action of the verb replace, with -ment turning the act into a thing you can talk about.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词首先给动词 replace 的动作命名，-ment 把动作变成可以谈论的对象。

senses.title: A thing used instead
senses.definition: a new part or object used in place of one that is broken or old
senses.definitionCN: 用来代替破损或陈旧部件的新零件或新物件
senses.example: The shop ordered a replacement for the damaged screen.
senses.exampleCN: 店里订购了一块屏幕来替换受损的那块。
senses.why: From the act of replacing it is a short step to naming the item that carries the act out.
senses.whyCN: 从替换动作出发，再往前一步就是命名执行替换的那个物件。

senses.title: A person who takes another's place
senses.definition: a person who does someone else's job or fills their position
senses.definitionCN: 接替他人工作或位置的人
senses.example: We need a replacement while she is on leave.
senses.exampleCN: 她休假期间我们需要一名替代者。
senses.why: People, like parts, can be slotted into a role, so the noun extends naturally to human stand-ins.
senses.whyCN: 人也可以像零件一样被放进某个角色，所以这个名词自然地扩展到人的替补。

intro.en: Replacement is formed inside English by adding the noun ending -ment to replace.
intro.cn: replacement 是英语内部在 replace 后加名词词尾 -ment 构成的。

items.en: The base place goes back to platea, a broad street or open position.
items.cn: 基础词 place 可上溯到 platea，指宽街或开阔的位置。

items.en: Old French place gives the sense of a spot, role, or room to occupy.
items.cn: 古法语 place 提供「位置、角色或可占据的空间」之意。

items.en: Replace is coined in English from re- and place.
items.cn: replace 是英语用 re- 与 place 创造出来的词。

items.en: The noun replacement appears as the act and result of replacing.
items.cn: 名词 replacement 出现，表示替换的动作及其结果。

items.en: Industrial usage spreads replacement for spare parts and substitute workers.
items.cn: 工业语境使 replacement 广泛用于备用零件和替代工人。

items.en: Modern English also uses it for medical procedures that swap a joint or organ.
items.cn: 现代英语还用它指更换关节或器官的医疗手术。

note.en: Replacement is the noun result of replace, and it is near words for stand-ins and renewals.
note.cn: replacement 是 replace 的名词结果，与表示替补和更新的词相邻。

entries.definition: to put back or take the place of
able to be replaced
too special to be replaced
a person or thing used instead of another
a person who takes over a role after another
a person who takes another's place temporarily
the act of making something new again

normalIntro.en: Replacement is replace plus -ment, so everything you know about replace transfers, with one extra step: the act becomes a noun.
normalIntro.cn: replacement 就是 replace 加 -ment，关于 replace 的知识都能迁移过来，只多一步：动作变成名词。

normal.en: Add -ment to replace and you get the act or the thing that replaces.
normal.cn: replace 加 -ment，就得到替换的动作或执行替换的东西。

normal.en: A replacement part is a part that fills the same slot.
normal.cn: replacement part 就是填进同一个位置的零件。

normal.en: A replacement player sits ready on the bench.
normal.cn: replacement player 就是坐在替补席上随时准备上场的人。

normal.en: The phrase a replacement for marks what is being swapped out.
normal.cn: a replacement for 标出被替换掉的对象。

normal.en: Irreplaceable means no replacement can be found.
normal.cn: irreplaceable 意为找不到替代者。

abstract.en: Picture a name plate unscrewed and another screwed into the same holes.
abstract.cn: 想象一块名牌被拧下，另一块拧进同样的孔位。

abstract.en: Imagine a substitute runner waiting at the edge of the track.
abstract.cn: 想象一名替补跑者等在跑道边。

abstract.en: Think of a spare part box labelled for the machine it belongs to.
abstract.cn: 想象一个贴着机器编号的备件盒。

examples.en: The replacement of the roof will start in spring.
examples.cn: 屋顶的更换工程将于春天开始。

examples.en: She ordered a replacement for her broken phone.
examples.cn: 她为坏掉的手机订了一台替代品。

examples.en: The team found a replacement for the injured goalkeeper.
examples.cn: 球队为受伤的门将找到了一名替补。

dict_mnemonic.text: replace（替换）+ -ment（名词词尾）＝替换这件事或替代者；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: replace（替换，由 re- 与 place 构成）+ 名词词尾 -ment，表示替换的行为、被替换上的物件或接替位置的人。

sensesIntro.en: The act comes first, then the object that carries it out, then the person who fills the role.
sensesIntro.cn: 先有替换的动作，再有执行替换的物件，最后是接替位置的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a vacant position filled by a new person or part.
core.cn: 核心意象：空出的位置由新的人或零件补上。

branches.en: The act of swapping is the noun's most general sense.
branches.cn: 对换的动作，是这个名词最概括的义项。

branches.en: A replacement can be the part or object that is swapped in.
branches.cn: replacement 也可以指被换上去的零件或物件。

branches.en: A person who fills the role is the human form of the same idea.
branches.cn: 填补角色的人，是同一想法的「人」的形态。

branches.en: The action and the object are inseparable parts of one handover.
branches.cn: 动作与物件是一次交接中不可分割的两部分。

branches.en: Parts and people both slot into a role that must keep running.
branches.cn: 零件和人都会被放进一个必须继续运转的角色。

intro.en: Replacement combines an English verb with a Latin-derived noun ending.
intro.cn: replacement 把一个英语动词与源自拉丁语的名词词尾结合起来。

latinIntro.en: The Latin platea gives place, and the ending -ment comes from Latin -mentum, marking an action or its result.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 platea 提供 place，词尾 -ment 来自拉丁语 -mentum，表示动作或其结果。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 replace 开头。

items.example: Place is the base of replacement.
items.exampleCN: place 是 replacement 的基础词。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ment 构成 replacement。
replace 给 replacement 提供意义。

items.meaning: the act or thing that replaces
items.exampleCN: replacement 在 replace 后加 -ment。

items.example: Replaceable and replacement share the replace stem.
items.exampleCN: replaceable 与 replacement 共享 replace 词干。
irreplaceable 用 ir- 否定 replaceable。
词尾 -able 构成 replaceable。

definition_en: to answer someone in words, in writing, or with an action
core_image: 一封信寄出去，几天后另一封信折返回来，落在同一个信箱里
scene: 她发出邮件后一直盯着屏幕，半小时后终于收到对方的回复。She smiled when her colleague replied with a single word: yes.
sceneCN: 这里 reply 是「回复；答复」（第 2 个义项：以书面形式作答）；句意：同事只回了一个「是」，她笑了。

senses.title: To answer in words
senses.definition: to say or write something as an answer to a question or message
senses.definitionCN: 针对问题或信息说出或写下回答
senses.example: He replied that he would arrive at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 他回答说中午到。
senses.why: The Latin verb replicare means to fold back, so a reply is words sent back to the one who spoke first.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词 replicare 意为「折回」，所以 reply 就是把话折回给先开口的人。

senses.title: A written answer
senses.definition: a written answer to a letter, email, or formal request
senses.definitionCN: 对信件、电子邮件或正式请求的书面答复
senses.example: I sent the report on Monday and am still waiting for a reply.
senses.exampleCN: 我周一发了报告，现在还在等回复。
senses.why: Writing is a channel for the same returning message, so the noun covers letters and emails.
senses.whyCN: 书写只是同一条「回传信息」的渠道，所以名词义项涵盖信件和邮件。

senses.title: To respond with an action
senses.definition: to react to an action with another action
senses.definitionCN: 用另一个行动来回应某个行动
senses.example: The soldiers replied to the attack with warning shots.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵鸣枪示警，作为对袭击的回应。
senses.why: When words give way to deeds, the fold-back pattern still holds, which extends reply to actions.
senses.whyCN: 当言语让位于行动时，「折回」的模式仍在，于是 reply 也扩展到行动。

intro.en: Reply comes through Old French from Latin replicare, to fold back, built from re- and plicare, to fold.
intro.cn: reply 经由古法语来自拉丁语 replicare（折回），由 re- 与 plicare（折叠）构成。

items.en: Plicare means to fold, bend, or weave.
items.cn: plicare 意为折叠、弯曲或编织。

items.en: Replicare adds re-, back, and means to fold something back on itself.
items.cn: replicare 加上 re-（回），意为把某物折回自身。

items.en: Replicare develops the sense of answering or responding to a charge.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语中，replicare 发展出「答复、回应指控」的意思。

items.en: Old French replier means to fold back and also to answer.
items.cn: 古法语 replier 既指折回，也指回答。

items.en: Middle English replien keeps the answer sense and drops the folding image.
items.cn: 中古英语 replien 保留「回答」义，折纸的画面逐渐淡去。

items.en: Modern English reply covers spoken, written, and acted responses.
items.cn: 现代英语 reply 涵盖口头、书面和行动上的回应。

note.en: Reply shares its Latin folding root with replica and replicate, while its meaning sits with answer and respond.
note.cn: reply 与 replica、replicate 共享拉丁语「折叠」词根，而词义上与 answer、respond 相邻。

entries.definition: an exact copy of an object
to copy something exactly
the act of copying or reproducing
to say something back to a question
to react to something said or done
to answer quickly, often sharply
to act in response to an event

normalIntro.en: Reply contains pli, the folding root also seen in ply and replicate, so the memory image is a message folded back to the sender.
normalIntro.cn: reply 含有 pli 这个「折叠」词根，也见于 ply 和 replicate，所以记忆画面是「把信息折回给发送者」。

normal.en: Re- means back, and ply means fold: fold the message back to the sender.
normal.cn: re- 表示回，ply 表示折：把信息折回给发送者。

normal.en: Reply to is the phrase that marks the person or message being answered.
normal.cn: reply to 标出被回复的人或信息。

normal.en: In reply is a fixed phrase meaning as an answer.
normal.cn: in reply 是固定短语，意为「作为答复」。

normal.en: No reply is what an empty inbox says.
normal.cn: no reply 就是空邮箱传达的状态。

normal.en: Compare replica: a replica is a copy folded back from an original.
normal.cn: 对比 replica：复制品是从原件「折回」的副本。

abstract.en: Picture a paper plane flying back to the hand that threw it.
abstract.cn: 想象纸飞机飞回扔出它的那只手。

abstract.en: Imagine a letter returning to the same mailbox days later.
abstract.cn: 想象几天后一封信回到同一个信箱。

abstract.en: Think of a question bouncing off a wall and coming back as an answer.
abstract.cn: 想象问题撞到墙上，反弹回来变成答案。

examples.en: She replied to the invitation the same day.
examples.cn: 她当天就回复了邀请。

examples.en: His reply was short but polite.
examples.cn: 他的回复简短而有礼貌。

examples.en: The company replied to the complaint with an apology.
examples.cn: 公司以道歉回应了投诉。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（回）+ ply（折）＝把话折回去，即回答；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）+ plicare（折叠）→ replicare（折回、答复）→ 古法语 replier → 中古英语 reply，指把话折回给发问者。

sensesIntro.en: A message folded back is the core: first spoken words, then written answers, then actions that answer actions.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「把信息折回去」：先说出口的回答，再是书面答复，最后是以行动回应行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a message folded back to the person who sent the first one.
core.cn: 核心意象：信息被折回给最先发出它的那个人。

branches.en: Spoken words sent back are the original verbal sense.
branches.cn: 把话送回去，是最早的言语义项。

branches.en: A letter or email carries the same return into writing.
branches.cn: 信件或邮件把同样的「返回」带入书面形式。

branches.en: An action can answer another action, extending the pattern beyond words.
branches.cn: 一个行动可以回应另一个行动，使这个模式超出言语。

branches.en: Speech and writing are two channels of the same answer.
branches.cn: 口头与书面是同一个答复的两条渠道。

branches.en: Words and deeds both complete the return loop.
branches.cn: 言语与行动都完成同一条回环。

intro.en: Reply is a French-shaped verb built on a Latin prefix and a Latin folding root.
intro.cn: reply 是法语形态的动词，建立在拉丁前缀与拉丁「折叠」词根之上。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means back, and plicare means to fold, so replicare is to fold back.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示回，plicare 表示折叠，所以 replicare 就是「折回」。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 reply 与 return 开头。

items.example: Plicare is the folding root behind reply.
items.exampleCN: plicare 是 reply 背后的「折叠」词根。
replicare 由 re- 与 plicare 合成。

items.example: Reply comes through French from replicare.
items.exampleCN: reply 经法语来自 replicare。
replier 在 reply 后加 -er。

items.example: Replica shares the folding root with reply.
items.exampleCN: replica 与 reply 共享「折叠」词根。

items.example: Replicate comes from the same Latin verb.
items.exampleCN: replicate 来自同一个拉丁动词。
词尾 -er 构成 replier。

definition_en: a spoken or written account of something, especially one given after watching or investigating it
core_image: 一个人把现场看到的事带回总部，摊开记录本一条条讲清楚
scene: 记者在雨里连线直播间，把刚刚发生的车祸报道给全国观众。The reporter described the crash in a live report from the road.
sceneCN: 这里 report 是「报道；新闻报告」（第 2 个义项：媒体对事件的叙述）；句意：记者在路边直播中描述了这起撞车事故。

senses.title: An account of facts
senses.definition: a spoken or written description of an event or situation, based on observation or study
senses.definitionCN: 基于观察或研究，对事件或情况作出的口头或书面叙述
senses.example: The committee published its report on air quality.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会发布了空气质量报告。
senses.why: The Latin source means to carry back, so the core sense is information brought back from a place or event.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源意为「搬回来」，所以核心义是把某地或某事件的信息带回来。

senses.title: A news story
senses.definition: an article or broadcast that tells the public about a recent event
senses.definitionCN: 向公众讲述近期事件的报道文章或广播节目
senses.example: The evening report led with the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 晚间报道以暴风雨为头条。
senses.why: Journalism turns the carried-back account into a public product, which becomes the news sense.
senses.whyCN: 新闻业把「带回来的叙述」变成面向公众的产品，于是产生新闻报道义。

senses.title: To give an official account
senses.definition: to tell an authority about something that has happened
senses.definitionCN: 向权威机构说明已经发生的事情
senses.example: She reported the theft to the police.
senses.exampleCN: 她向警方报了盗窃案。
senses.why: Reporting is the act of carrying information to someone who needs it, especially an authority.
senses.whyCN: report 就是把信息带给需要它的人，尤其是权威机构。

senses.title: To be accountable to
senses.definition: to be managed by or responsible to a particular person
senses.definitionCN: 受某位上级管理，或对其负责
senses.example: The new assistant reports directly to the director.
senses.exampleCN: 新助理直接向主任汇报。
senses.why: If information must be carried to a superior, then the person doing the carrying is under that superior.
senses.whyCN: 如果信息必须传给上级，那么负责传递的人就处于该上级的管理之下。

intro.en: Report comes from Latin reportare, to carry back, built from re-, back, and portare, to carry.
intro.cn: report 来自拉丁语 reportare（搬回），由 re-（回）与 portare（搬运）构成。

items.en: Portare means to carry, and it is the source of transport and portable.
items.cn: portare 意为搬运，是 transport 与 portable 的来源。

items.en: Reportare adds re-, back, and means to bring news or an answer back.
items.cn: reportare 加上 re-（回），意为把消息或答复带回来。

items.en: Old French reporter keeps the sense of telling what has been learned.
items.cn: 古法语 reporter 保留「讲述所知」的意思。

items.en: Middle English report covers both the telling and the written account.
items.cn: 中古英语 report 既指讲述，也指书面记录。

items.en: Newspapers give report the specialised sense of a news item.
items.cn: 报纸赋予 report「新闻条目」的专门含义。

items.en: Modern English adds the workplace sense of answering to a manager.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了职场中「向管理者汇报」的用法。

note.en: Report is a carrying-back word, and its family includes the person who carries the news and the style of news writing.
note.cn: report 是一个「带回信息」的词，其词族包括带消息的人和新闻写作文体。

entries.definition: a person who gathers and tells news
according to what people say
the style of reporting news in writing
a description of an event
something said or written officially
a written note of facts kept for the future
a short official news report

normalIntro.en: Report contains port, the carrying root of transport, so the memory picture is carrying information back from the scene.
normalIntro.cn: report 含有 port 这个「搬运」词根，也见于 transport，所以记忆画面是从现场把信息搬回来。

normal.en: Re- means back, and port means carry: carry the news back.
normal.cn: re- 表示回，port 表示搬运：把消息搬回来。

normal.en: A reporter is the person who does the carrying.
normal.cn: reporter 就是负责搬运消息的人。

normal.en: Report to your manager means carry information to that manager.
normal.cn: report to your manager 就是把信息带到经理那里。

normal.en: A news report is information carried back to the public.
normal.cn: news report 就是带回给公众的信息。

normal.en: Report a crime is the official version of telling what happened.
normal.cn: report a crime 是「说明发生了什么」的正式说法。

abstract.en: Picture a messenger running from the battlefield back to the camp.
abstract.cn: 想象信使从战场跑回营地。

abstract.en: Imagine a notebook filled at the scene and read aloud in an office.
abstract.cn: 想象在现场写满的笔记本，在办公室里被大声读出来。

abstract.en: Think of a microphone carrying a voice from the street into a studio.
abstract.cn: 想象麦克风把街上的声音送进演播室。

examples.en: The report shows a sharp rise in house prices.
examples.cn: 这份报告显示房价大幅上涨。

examples.en: The theft was reported to the police at once.
examples.cn: 盗窃案立即报了警。

examples.en: She reports to the head of the department.
examples.cn: 她向部门负责人汇报。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（回）+ port（搬运）＝把消息搬回来，即报告；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）+ portare（搬运）→ reportare（带回消息）→ 古法语 reporter → 中古英语 report。

sensesIntro.en: Information carried back becomes the account, then the published news story, then the act of informing an authority, and finally the line of duty to a manager.
sensesIntro.cn: 被带回的信息先成为叙述，再成为公开的新闻报道，然后是向权威报告的动作，最后是向管理者负责的隶属关系。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: information carried back from the scene to the people who need it.
core.cn: 核心意象：信息从现场被带回给需要它的人。

branches.en: The account itself is the basic noun sense.
branches.cn: 叙述本身，是最基本的名词义项。

branches.en: Carried-back information becomes a public news story.
branches.cn: 带回的信息变成面向公众的新闻报道。

branches.en: Carrying information to an authority is the official verb.
branches.cn: 把信息带给权威机构，是正式的动词用法。

branches.en: The one who carries information upward is accountable to that superior.
branches.cn: 向上传递信息的人，对那位上级负责。

branches.en: A private account and a public news item share the same content and direction.
branches.cn: 内部叙述与公开新闻共享同样的内容和方向。

intro.en: Report is built from a Latin prefix and a Latin carrying root, with an English noun-and-verb shape.
intro.cn: report 由拉丁前缀与拉丁「搬运」词根构成，在英语中兼作名词和动词。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means back, and portare means to carry, so reportare is to carry something back.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示回，portare 表示搬运，所以 reportare 就是「把东西搬回来」。

items.example: Portare is the root of report and transport.

reportare 由 re- 与 portare 合成。
report 保留了「带回」的画面。

reportage 在 report 后加 -age。

items.exampleCN: 词尾 -age 构成 reportage。

definition_en: a person whose job is to gather news and tell the public about it
core_image: 拿着话筒和笔记本的人，把远处的消息带回编辑部
scene: 发布会还没结束，前排的记者已经把要点发回编辑部。The reporter filed the story before the room emptied.
sceneCN: 这里 reporter 是「记者」（第 1 个义项：采集并报道新闻的人）；句意：记者在会场散场前就把报道发了回去。

senses.title: A news journalist
senses.definition: a person who collects information and writes or broadcasts news
senses.definitionCN: 采集信息并撰写或播报新闻的人
senses.example: A reporter stopped him outside the station.
senses.exampleCN: 一名记者在车站外拦住了他。
senses.why: The -er ending marks the person who performs the action of reporting, so the basic sense is the news worker.
senses.whyCN: -er 词尾标记执行 report 这一动作的人，所以基本义就是新闻工作者。

senses.title: A person who reports something
senses.definition: someone who gives an official account of an event to an authority
senses.definitionCN: 向权威机构正式说明某事件的人
senses.example: The reporter of the accident gave a clear statement.
senses.exampleCN: 事故报告人作了清楚的陈述。
senses.why: Anyone who carries information to an authority can be called a reporter, not only a journalist.
senses.whyCN: 任何把信息带给权威机构的人都可以叫 reporter，并不限于记者。

senses.title: A court stenographer
senses.definition: a person who records the words spoken in a court
senses.definitionCN: 记录法庭上发言内容的人
senses.example: The court reporter typed every word of the testimony.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭记录员打下了证词的每一个字。
senses.why: Recording speech for the record is another specialised form of reporting what was said.
senses.whyCN: 为存档记录发言，是「报告所说内容」的另一种专业形式。

intro.en: Reporter is report plus the agent ending -er, so it names the person who carries information back.
intro.cn: reporter 是 report 加施事词尾 -er，指把信息带回来的人。

items.en: Reportare means to carry back news, from re- and portare.
items.cn: reportare 意为带回消息，由 re- 与 portare 构成。

items.en: Old French reporter supplies the verb that English shortens to report.
items.cn: 古法语 reporter 提供动词，英语将其简化为 report。

items.en: Middle English report names both the telling and the account.
items.cn: 中古英语 report 既指讲述，也指叙述。

items.en: The agent noun reporter appears for someone who brings news.
items.cn: 施事名词 reporter 出现，指带来消息的人。

items.en: Newspapers make reporter a regular job title.
items.cn: 报纸使 reporter 成为固定的职业名称。

items.en: Modern English extends it to court recorders and official informants.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到法庭记录员和正式报告人。

note.en: Reporter is the person noun of the report family, and it sits beside other names for news workers.
note.cn: reporter 是 report 词族中表示人的名词，与其它新闻工作者名称相邻。

normal.en: Report plus -er: the one who carries the news back.
normal.cn: report 加 -er：把消息带回来的人。

normal.en: A court reporter records what is said in court.

abstract.cn: 想象笔记本和话筒在人群中移动。

abstract.cn: 想象前排挂着记者证的挂绳。

abstract.en: Think of a voice sending facts from a dark street into a bright studio.
abstract.cn: 想象一个声音把事实从暗街送进明亮的演播室。

examples.en: The reporter interviewed three witnesses.
examples.cn: 记者采访了三名目击者。

examples.en: She works as a sports reporter for a local paper.
examples.cn: 她在一家地方报纸做体育记者。

examples.en: Reporters waited outside the court for a statement.
examples.cn: 记者们在法庭外等待声明。

root: report（报告，源自拉丁语 reportare「带回」）+ 施事词尾 -er，指采集并传递消息的人。

sensesIntro.en: The suffix -er gives the person: first the news worker, then anyone who reports officially, then the court recorder.
sensesIntro.cn: 词尾 -er 给出「人」：先是新闻工作者，再是任何正式报告者，最后是法庭记录员。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person carrying news from the scene back to the desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人把消息从现场带回编辑桌。

branches.en: The news worker is the everyday and central sense.
branches.cn: 新闻工作者，是最日常、最核心的义项。

branches.en: Anyone who gives an official account is a reporter in the broad sense.
branches.cn: 任何作出正式陈述的人，都是广义上的报告人。

branches.en: The court recorder reports speech into a permanent record.
branches.cn: 法庭记录员把发言报告成永久记录。

branches.en: Journalist and official informant both carry information to others.
branches.cn: 记者与正式报告人都在把信息带给他人。

branches.en: Both gather words at the scene and preserve them for later readers.
branches.cn: 两者都在现场收集话语，并为后来的读者保存。

intro.en: Reporter is a transparent English agent noun: report plus -er.
intro.cn: reporter 是一个构词透明的英语施事名词：report 加 -er。

latinIntro.en: The base report comes from Latin reportare, to carry back, and -er marks the person who does it.
latinIntro.cn: 基础词 report 来自拉丁语 reportare（带回），-er 标记执行该动作的人。

items.example: Report is the base of reporter.
items.exampleCN: report 是 reporter 的基础词。

items.example: The suffix -er turns report into reporter.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -er 把 report 变成 reporter。
reporter 由 report 与 -er 合成。
reporters 在 reporter 后加 -s。

definition_en: to act or speak for someone, to stand for something, or to show something in a picture or description
core_image: 一个人站在一群人前面，把大家的意思带到会议桌上
scene: 村里选出一个人去城里开会，他要代表所有住户表达对修路的需求。She was chosen to represent the village at the meeting.
sceneCN: 这里 represent 是「代表」（第 1 个义项：代替某人或某群体发言、行事）；句意：她被选出来代表全村去开会。

senses.title: To act or speak for others
senses.definition: to act or speak officially for a person, group, or organization
senses.definitionCN: 正式代替某人、某群体或某组织行事或发言
senses.example: The lawyer represents several families in the case.
senses.exampleCN: 这位律师在案件中代表好几个家庭。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to make present, so representing is making an absent group present through one person.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「使在场」，所以代表就是让不在场的群体通过一个人「到场」。

senses.title: To stand for something
senses.definition: to be a sign or symbol of something
senses.definitionCN: 作为某事物的标志或象征
senses.example: On the map, a red dot represents a hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 在地图上，红点表示医院。
senses.why: A symbol makes an idea present to the eye, which is the same logic as a person standing for a group.
senses.whyCN: 符号让一个概念在眼前「在场」，这与人代表群体的逻辑相同。

senses.title: To show in picture or words
senses.definition: to describe or show something in a particular way
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式描述或呈现某事物
senses.example: The painting represents the harvest as a celebration.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅画把丰收描绘成一场庆典。
senses.why: A picture makes a scene present again, extending the core idea from people to images.
senses.whyCN: 图画让一个场景再次「在场」，把核心概念从人扩展到图像。

senses.title: To amount to something
senses.definition: to be equivalent to something, or to count as an example of it
senses.definitionCN: 等同于某事物，或算作某事物的一例
senses.example: The delay represents a serious loss for the company.
senses.exampleCN: 这次延误对公司来说相当于严重损失。
senses.why: If something stands for a value or result, it can also count as that result in practice.
senses.whyCN: 如果某物代表某种价值或结果，它在实际中也就可以算作那个结果。

intro.en: Represent comes from Latin repraesentare, to make present, built from re- and praesentare, to present.
intro.cn: represent 来自拉丁语 repraesentare（使在场），由 re- 与 praesentare（呈现）构成。

items.en: Praesens means present or being at hand, and praesentare means to make present.
items.cn: praesens 意为在场的、手边的，praesentare 意为使在场。

items.en: Repraesentare adds re- and means to bring something before the eyes or mind.
items.cn: repraesentare 加上 re-，意为把某物带到眼前或心中。

items.en: The verb is used for showing an image, a person, or an idea.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语中，该动词用于呈现图像、人物或观念。

items.en: Old French representer carries the senses of showing and standing for.
items.cn: 古法语 representer 同时有「展示」和「代表」的意思。

items.en: Middle English represent covers speaking for others and depicting scenes.
items.cn: 中古英语 represent 涵盖替人发言和描绘场景。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of amounting to or constituting something.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「相当于、构成」这一义项。

note.en: Represent is the verb at the centre of a family about standing in for something, and it sits near words for symbol and depiction.
note.cn: represent 是「代替某物出场」这一词族的中心动词，与表示象征和描绘的词相邻。

showing things as they appear in real life

normalIntro.en: Represent is re- plus present, so the memory hook is making something present again through a person, sign, or picture.
normalIntro.cn: represent 就是 re- 加 present，记忆钩子是「通过人、符号或图画让某物再次在场」。

normal.en: Re- means again, and present means here: make the group present again through one speaker.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，present 表示在场：通过一个发言者让群体再次到场。

normal.en: A red dot on a map represents a hospital by making it visible.
normal.cn: 地图上的红点通过「可见」来代表医院。

normal.en: The ending -ation turns the verb into the noun representation.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ation 把动词变成名词 representation。

normal.en: The ending -ative turns it into representative, the person or the adjective.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ative 把它变成 representative，可指人或作形容词。

normal.en: Represent an improvement means the thing amounts to an improvement.
normal.cn: represent an improvement 意为该事物相当于一种改进。

abstract.en: Picture one person carrying a whole village's questions into a meeting room.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人把整个村子的问题带进会议室。

abstract.en: Imagine a small icon standing in for a large building on a screen.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上一枚小图标代替一栋大楼。

abstract.en: Think of a portrait making an absent face look present.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅肖像让不在场的面孔重新出现。

examples.en: She represents the company in Asia.
examples.cn: 她代表公司在亚洲开展工作。

examples.en: In this diagram, each circle represents a cell.
examples.cn: 在这张图里，每个圆圈表示一个细胞。

examples.en: The new rules represent a major change.
examples.cn: 新规定相当于一次重大变化。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（再次）+ present（呈现）＝让不在场的人或事再次呈现，即代表；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次）+ praesens（在场的）→ praesentare（使在场）→ repraesentare（呈现、代表）→ 古法语 representer → 中古英语 represent。

sensesIntro.en: Making something present is the core: a person makes a group present, a sign makes an idea present, a picture makes a scene present, and a fact can make a result present.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「使某物在场」：人让群体在场，符号让观念在场，图画让场景在场，而事实可以让结果在场。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one person or sign standing in so that something absent becomes present.
core.cn: 核心意象：由一个人或符号代替出场，使缺席之物重新在场。

branches.en: Acting for a group is the central political and legal sense.
branches.cn: 替群体行事，是最核心的政治与法律义项。

branches.en: A symbol makes an idea present to the eye.
branches.cn: 符号让观念在眼前呈现。

branches.en: A picture makes a scene present again in description.
branches.cn: 图画在描述中让场景再次呈现。

branches.en: A fact can make a consequence present by counting as it.
branches.cn: 事实可以通过「算作」某种后果而使之在场。

branches.en: Delegates and symbols both stand in for something larger.
branches.cn: 代表与符号都在代替更大的事物出场。

definition_en: the act of speaking or acting for others, or something such as an image or statement that stands for something else
core_image: 一张地图把整片山河缩在纸上，每个符号都对应真实的一处地方
scene: 律师翻着案卷，指出这份笔录没有准确反映当事人的原话。The lawyer argued that the representation of her words was unfair.
sceneCN: 这里 representation 是「描绘；表述」（第 2 个义项：以图像或文字再现某事物）；句意：律师认为对当事人原话的表述并不公平。

senses.title: The act of acting for others
senses.definition: the act of speaking or acting officially for a group of people
senses.definitionCN: 正式替一群人说或做的行为
senses.example: The region demands fair representation in parliament.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区要求在议会中获得公平的代表权。
senses.why: The noun names the action behind represent, and the political sense is the oldest public use.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词给 represent 背后的动作命名，其中政治代表义是最早的公共用法。

senses.title: An image or description
senses.definition: a picture, model, or description that shows something
senses.definitionCN: 展示某事物的图画、模型或描述
senses.example: The chart is a visual representation of the data.
senses.exampleCN: 这张图表是数据的可视化表现。
senses.why: A representation makes something present to the eye, so the product of showing becomes a sense of its own.
senses.whyCN: 表现让某物在眼前呈现，于是「呈现出来的成品」本身也成为一个义项。

senses.title: A formal statement
senses.definition: a formal statement made to an authority in order to influence a decision
senses.definitionCN: 向权威机构作出的正式陈述，用以影响决定
senses.example: The group made representations to the council about the road.
senses.exampleCN: 该团体就这条路向议会提出了陈述。
senses.why: Speaking for a group can take the form of an official statement, which inherits the same word.
senses.whyCN: 替群体发言可以采取正式陈述的形式，于是沿用了同一个词。

senses.title: Legal acting for a client
senses.definition: the work of a lawyer who speaks and acts for a client in a case
senses.definitionCN: 律师在案件中替当事人发言和行事的工作
senses.example: He cannot afford legal representation.
senses.exampleCN: 他请不起法律代理。
senses.why: Legal representation is a specialised branch of acting for someone else.
senses.whyCN: 法律代理是「替他人行事」的一个专门分支。

intro.en: Representation comes from Latin repraesentatio, the noun of repraesentare, to make present.
intro.cn: representation 来自拉丁名词 repraesentatio，是 repraesentare（使在场）的名词形式。

items.en: Repraesentare means to bring something before the eyes or mind.
items.cn: repraesentare 意为把某物带到眼前或心中。

items.en: Repraesentatio names the act of showing or making present.
items.cn: repraesentatio 指展示或使在场的动作。

items.en: Old French representation keeps the senses of image and official statement.
items.cn: 古法语 representation 保留「图像」和「正式陈述」两种含义。

items.en: Middle English representation is used for pictures, symbols, and spokesmen.
items.cn: 中古英语 representation 用于图画、符号和代言人。

items.en: Political writing develops the sense of elected representation.
items.cn: 政治写作发展出「选举代表制」的含义。

items.en: Modern English adds legal representation and data representation.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了法律代理和数据表示等用法。

note.en: Representation is the noun product of represent, and it is close to words for images, symbols, and formal statements.
note.cn: representation 是 represent 的名词产物，与表示图像、符号和正式陈述的词相邻。

a person chosen to act for others
showing things as they look
the act of showing something in a picture or words
the way a person or thing is shown

a sign that stands for something else

normalIntro.en: Representation is represent plus -ation, so it names the act or the product of making something present.
normalIntro.cn: representation 是 represent 加 -ation，指「使某物在场」的动作或其产物。

normal.en: Take represent, add -ation, and you have the noun for the whole process.
normal.cn: 取 represent 加 -ation，就得到指整个过程的名词。

normal.en: A graph is a representation of numbers you cannot see at once.
normal.cn: 图表是对无法一眼看尽的数字的表现。

normal.en: Proportional representation is the political version of the word.
normal.cn: proportional representation 是这个词的政治版本。

normal.en: Make representations means make a formal case to someone in power.
normal.cn: make representations 意为向掌权者正式陈述。

normal.en: Legal representation means a lawyer acts and speaks for you.
normal.cn: legal representation 意为律师替你行事和发言。

abstract.en: Picture a map folding a whole country into a pocket.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图把整个国家折进衣袋。

abstract.en: Imagine a portrait standing in for a person who is far away.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅肖像代替远方的一个人。

abstract.en: Think of an elected member carrying a district's voice into a chamber.
abstract.cn: 想象一名民选议员把选区的声音带进议事厅。

examples.en: The chart offers a clear representation of the results.
examples.cn: 这张图表清楚地呈现了结果。

examples.en: Women demanded greater representation in government.
examples.cn: 女性要求在政府中获得更多代表权。

examples.en: The embassy made representations about the detained citizens.
examples.cn: 大使馆就被拘留的公民进行了交涉。

dict_mnemonic.text: represent（代表、呈现）+ -ation（名词词尾）＝代表或表现；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 repraesentare（使在场、呈现）的名词形式 repraesentatio → 古法语 representation → 中古英语 representation。

sensesIntro.en: Acting for others comes first, then the image that shows something, then the official statement, and finally the lawyer who acts in court.
sensesIntro.cn: 先有替他人行事，再有展示某物的图像，然后是正式陈述，最后是法庭上代为行事的律师。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something absent shown or carried into the room by a stand-in.
core.cn: 核心意象：缺席之物由替身呈现，或被带进房间。

branches.en: Political representation carries a group into the chamber.
branches.cn: 政治代表把群体带进议事厅。

branches.en: An image or chart carries a thing into view.
branches.cn: 图像或图表把事物带进视野。

branches.en: A formal statement carries a case to an authority.
branches.cn: 正式陈述把诉求带给权威机构。

branches.en: Legal representation carries a client's voice into court.
branches.cn: 法律代理把当事人的声音带进法庭。

branches.en: Delegates and images both make something present in a different medium.
branches.cn: 代表与图像都在不同媒介中让某物在场。

intro.en: Representation is a Latin-shaped noun built on represent with the ending -ation.
intro.cn: representation 是在 represent 上加法语-拉丁名词词尾 -ation 构成的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin repraesentatio turns the act of making present into a noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 repraesentatio 把「使在场」的动作变成名词。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 represent 词干开头。
praesentare 提供 present 这一成分。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ation 构成 representation。

items.example: Represent is the base of representation.
items.exampleCN: represent 是 representation 的基础词。

items.meaning: the act or product of representing
items.exampleCN: representation 在 represent 后加 -ation。
representative 共享 represent 词干。
representational 在 representation 后加 -al。
词尾 -al 构成 representational。

definition_zh: 代表；代理人；典型的；有代表性的
definition_en: a person chosen to speak or act for a group, or something that is typical of a larger whole
core_image: 会议室里写着「村民代表」的牌子前，坐着一个被大家推选出来的人
scene: 全国各地的代表聚到首都，把各自选区的声音带进会场。Each representative carried the concerns of a different region.
sceneCN: 这里 representative 是「代表」（第 1 个义项：被选出替群体发言的人）；句意：每位代表都带来了不同地区的关切。

senses.title: A person chosen to act for others
senses.definition: someone who is chosen to speak or vote for a group of people
senses.definitionCN: 被选出替一群人发言或投票的人
senses.example: The union sent three representatives to the talks.
senses.exampleCN: 工会派了三名代表参加会谈。
senses.why: The -ative ending marks a person or thing that carries out the action of representing.
senses.whyCN: -ative 词尾标记执行「代表」这一动作的人或物。

senses.title: A typical example
senses.definition: typical of a group, so that it can be used as an example of the whole
senses.definitionCN: 能体现整个群体特征的，可作为整体的例子
senses.example: The survey used a representative sample of adults.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查使用了有代表性的成年人样本。
senses.why: If a person stands for a group, a sample can stand for a whole population in the same way.
senses.whyCN: 如果一个人能代表一个群体，一个样本也能以同样方式代表整个人群。

senses.title: Based on elected members
senses.definition: describing a system in which elected people make decisions for the public
senses.definitionCN: 描述由民选代表替公众作决定的制度
senses.example: The country has a representative government.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家实行代议制政府。
senses.why: A government made of representatives is simply the adjective form applied to a whole system.
senses.whyCN: 由代表组成的政府，只是把这个形容词用在整个制度上。

intro.en: Representative is formed inside English by adding -ative to represent, which comes from Latin repraesentare.
intro.cn: representative 是英语在 represent 后加 -ative 构成的，而 represent 来自拉丁语 repraesentare。

items.en: Repraesentare means to make present or bring before the eyes.
items.cn: repraesentare 意为使在场或带到眼前。

items.en: The ending -ativus marks something that performs or relates to an action.
items.cn: 词尾 -ativus 标记执行某动作或与之相关的事物。

items.en: Old French representer brings the verb into English.
items.cn: 古法语 representer 把动词带入英语。

items.en: Middle English uses representative for a person who stands for others.
items.cn: 中古英语用 representative 指替他人出场的人。

items.en: Political theory adopts representative for elected government.
items.cn: 政治理论采用 representative 指代议制政府。

items.en: Modern English extends it to samples and typical examples.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到样本和典型例子。

note.en: Representative is the person-or-adjective form of the represent family, and it is close to names for delegates and typical examples.
note.cn: representative 是 represent 词族中「人」或形容词的形态，与代表和典型例子的名称相邻。

entries.definition: to speak or act for others
the act of representing
showing things as they appear
a person sent to speak or vote for a group
a person who acts for someone else

showing the usual qualities of a group

normalIntro.en: Representative contains represent plus -ative, and the ending signals either a person who represents or an adjective meaning typical.
normalIntro.cn: representative 由 represent 加 -ative 构成，词尾要么指「执行代表的人」，要么是形容词「典型的」。

normal.en: Represent plus -ative: a person who does the representing.
normal.cn: represent 加 -ative：执行代表动作的人。

normal.en: A sales representative is the person who stands for the company to customers.
normal.cn: sales representative 就是公司对客户出面的那个人。

normal.en: A representative sample stands for the whole population.
normal.cn: representative sample 代表整个人群。

normal.en: Elected representative makes the political role explicit.
normal.cn: elected representative 明确点出政治角色。

normal.en: Representative of can mean typical of as well as speaking for.
normal.cn: representative of 既可指「代表」，也可指「典型体现」。

abstract.en: Picture a name card on a long table, marking one seat as the village's seat.
abstract.cn: 想象长桌上的一张名牌，把某个座位标为村子的座位。

abstract.en: Imagine one apple chosen to stand for a whole crate.
abstract.cn: 想象一个苹果被选出来代表整箱苹果。

abstract.en: Think of a spokesperson stepping up to a row of microphones.
abstract.cn: 想象发言人走到一排麦克风前。

examples.en: Each department elected a representative to the committee.
examples.cn: 每个部门都选了一名代表进入委员会。

examples.en: The study used a representative sample of students.
examples.cn: 这项研究使用了有代表性的学生样本。

examples.en: The painting is representative of his early style.
examples.cn: 这幅画代表了他的早期风格。

dict_mnemonic.text: represent（代表）+ -ative（人／形容词词尾）＝代表或典型的；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: represent（代表，源自拉丁语 repraesentare「使在场」）+ 词尾 -ative，表示执行代表动作的人，或具有代表性的事物。

sensesIntro.en: The person comes first, then the typical sample that stands for a whole, then the whole system built from such people.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是代人行事的人，再是代表整体的典型样本，最后是由这些人构成的整套制度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one chosen person or sample standing in for a larger whole.
core.cn: 核心意象：被选出的一个人或样本，代替更大的整体出场。

branches.en: The chosen person who speaks for others is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 被选出替他人发言的人，是基本义项。

branches.en: A sample can stand for a population just as a person stands for a group.
branches.cn: 样本代表总体，正如人代表群体。

branches.en: A whole system can be built out of elected representatives.
branches.cn: 整套制度可以由民选代表构成。

branches.en: Person and sample both work by standing in for something larger.
branches.cn: 人与样本都通过代替更大的事物来发挥作用。

branches.en: Elected individuals and representative government share the same political logic.
branches.cn: 民选个人与代议制政府共享同一套政治逻辑。

intro.en: Representative is an English adjective-and-noun form built on the Latin verb represent.
intro.cn: representative 是在拉丁动词 represent 基础上构成的英语形容词兼名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ending -ativus marks something that performs an action, so representative names the one who makes others present.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词尾 -ativus 标记执行动作的事物，所以 representative 指「使他人出场的人」。

items.exampleCN: represent 是 representative 的基础词。

representation 共享 represent 词干。

representativeness 在 representative 后加 -ness。
